name: The Fool
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one original tarot card illustration, THE FOOL, for a full Francis Bacon-inspired deck. Draw on the painter Francis Bacon's expressive distortion, psychological intensity, rubbed and smeared oil paint, isolated bodies in severe geometric enclosures, warm flat fields and visceral gestural mark-making. Create an original composition, not a copy of any existing painting. One full-length adult traveler in a simple pale cream suit takes a tentative step from a small angular platform; a small living white dog and a tiny travel bundle provide readable Fool symbolism. The adult's face and torso are distorted through layered motion smears and painted contours, but the poised stance, limbs, dog and bundle remain distinct. A fine open wirelike cubic frame surrounds the figure, a circular pale floor beneath, a large burnt-orange ground with oxblood and smoky mauve accents, deep charcoal void on one side. Figure occupies central two-thirds. Restrained raw painterly texture and scumbled white highlights, tension between flat space and vigorously worked flesh-toned paint. The mood is the vulnerable courage of a beginning, existential and dreamlike. No injury, wounds, blood, gore, nudity or suffering animal. Portrait 3:5, highest available resolution, one complete flat illustration with important forms inside central 85%. No text, lettering, numbers, frame decoration, artist signature, watermark, mockup or surrounding surface. Leave quiet margin space for consistent card titles added later.
